column5: Write the first word with a capital letter. ___ cat is soft. => Write the word the with a capital letter to start the sentence. ___ cat is soft.
I like rice! was also defensible => option ! replaced by comma
Dad sorted as always needing a capital (my dad does not) => Dewi
The two-letter sounds are sh, ch, th and ng. => Two-letter sounds include sh, ch, th and ng.
Feel your mouth. Is your tongue behind your teeth, or do your lips push out? => Feel your mouth. Is the sound quick, or can you hold it for a long time?
The ba__ is in the tub also fits ball (ll) => I wash in the ba__.
The last sound comes from the back of your throat. => The last sound is made at the back of your mouth.
Three of the words have one. => Two of the words have one.
Which word is spelt right? with tank as a wrong option (tank is spelt right) => Which word fits? I say ___ you to my friend.
Listen to the first two letters. => Listen to the first sound.
Naming words are things you can see or touch. => Many naming words are things you can see or touch.
A naming word is a thing, a person or an animal. => A naming word can be a thing, a person, an animal or a place.
hot tea / sweet cake could swap to sweet tea / hot cake => pair hot + sun
In a question, two words swap places. => In this question, two words swap places.
A question starts with a question word. => This question starts with a question word.
Telling sentences give facts. => Telling sentences tell us something.
___ you like milk? keyed only Do => also accepts Did and Would
Find the colour word and the doing word. => Find the colour word and the word holds.
Three of them end like bell. => Two of them end like bell.
Rhyming words have the same vowel. => Rhyming words have the same vowel sound.
The lines end with two words. => Each line ends with one of the two words.
Look for the words first, then, and after that. => Look for the words then and after that.
A story tells about people and what happens to them. => A story tells about people or animals and what happens to them.
Look for a sentence about all bees. => Look for a sentence about bees, not about one person.

Sentences about named people are stories. Sentences about animals or the sun are facts. => Bo, Zia and Pak Ali are people in a story, and we read what they did. The other sentences give facts about frogs, the sun and fish.
The problem gets solved. => The problem often gets solved.
Monday comes first and Tuesday second. => In this list, Monday comes first and Tuesday second.
The last letter is wrong. => The middle letter is wrong.
Write the missing word. I have ___ red hat. => Write the missing word. It has one letter. I have ___ red hat.
Write the missing word. We ___ at school today. => Write am, is or are. We ___ at school today.
They has the letters ey in the middle. => They ends with the letters ey.
Two words in each wrong sentence are tricky. => Each wrong sentence has one word spelt wrong.
It sounds like the word nine. => It has the same long i sound as the word nine.
Three words have the same long sound. => Two words have the same long sound.
Plural -es rule stated as always (fish, ox, stomach are counterexamples) => usually, in .003 .004 .009 .018 .019 .023 .028 .703
After is, we use the -ing word. => Here, after is, we use the -ing word.
After is we use a word that ends in -ing. => Here, after is, we use a word that ends in -ing.
The word is, tells you it is happening now. => The word is tells you it is happening now.
Mina fed her cat every day is also correct => option fed replaced by feed
When a short word ends in one letter after a vowel, we double the n. => Run has a short vowel and ends in one consonant, so we double the n.
You can see them all when you look at the sky. => You notice them all when you go outside.
Family words are people at home. => Family words name people in your family.
Warm is nearly the same as hot. => Warm is a little bit hot, so it is not the opposite.
Which word does not belong? => Which word does not belong? red, blue, green, chair
Look for words that have legs or wings. => Look for things that can walk, hop or fly.
Think of going to the other way. => Think of going the other way.
opposite of happy keyed only sad => also accepts unhappy
It is a word for something very big. => It is another word for big.
A bird lives in a tree. => A bird can live in a tree.
Think of a different word for small. => What is the opposite of big?
My favourite food is fried rice. It is yummy. => My favourite food is fried rice because it is yummy.
Write the doing word. A fish can ___ in water. => Write the doing word. It starts with sw. A fish can ___ in water.
